mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND TRUNC(s.SEM_END_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inProgressFlag, e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, NVL(l.LEC_TOT_CLASSES, 0) AS totalSessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'PRS') AS present, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'LAT') AS late, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'ABS') AS absent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID) AS attendanceTotal FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND l.LEC_VAL_STATUS != 'CNCL' ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, CASE s.SEM_TERM WHEN 'WNT' THEN 4 WHEN 'SM2' THEN 3 WHEN 'SMR' THEN 2 WHEN 'SM1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_SECTION, l.LEC_ID

SELECT a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE AS statusCode, TO_CHAR(a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS attendanceDate FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND l.LEC_VAL_STATUS != 'CNCL' AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE IN ('LAT', 'ABS') ORDER BY a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE
